text:
maria: Noticed an unexpected RoleBinding grant in the audit stream during the 03:10 deploy window. No associated PR. pinging @owen @paula for quick triage
ci-bot: [pipeline] pipeline-run-914 completed. logs: https://ci.internal/pipelines/914
owen: Pulled matching audit entries. Entry at 2026-03-21T03:10:27Z, protoPayload.methodName="io.k8s.rbac.v1.RoleBinding.create" subject=serviceAccount:ingest-tester@redwood. No github_user in authz.
paula: Which pipeline step ran kube-mods? I recall we moved RBAC changes to a manual approval step.
maria: The pipeline YAML shows `post-deploy` includes `scripts/infra-sync.sh` which runs `kubectl apply -f infra/rbac-temporary.yaml` when ENV=staging. That seems like the culprit.
owen: Also saw Secret Manager access at 03:10:20Z for secret=projects/infra/secrets/ingest-test-token by pipeline-runner@ci. Then the job executed as svc-ingest at 03:10:25Z. Request IDs line up: req-a1b2c3.
raj: DAST (dynamic-scan-bot) flagged a redirect from /oauth/complete at 03:10:29Z. It followed a 302 to an external host. Could be crawler hitting a test harness with env token — possibly false positive.
paula: Immediate steps: 1) delete the RoleBinding if still present; 2) freeze the pipeline to prevent re-run; 3) collect KMS logs and secret access logs for 03:05-03:20Z; 4) correlate DAST run id with pipeline run. I can take 1 and 2 now. @maria can you do 3?
maria: On it. KMS log query I ran: `logName="projects/infra/logs/cloudkms.googleapis.com%2Factivity" protoPayload.resourceName:"keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-key" timestamp>="2026-03-21T03:05:00Z" timestamp<="2026-03-21T03:20:00Z"` — results: no decrypt operations by svc-ingest. Secret Manager shows access by pipeline-runner at 03:10:19Z and then svc-ingest executed the job.
owen: Deleted RoleBinding at 03:14:03Z. audit shows RoleBinding.delete with same req-a1b2c3.
paula: Pipeline frozen and manual approval required moved into gate. Also opened PR to remove `kubectl apply` from post-deploy and add a validated RBAC diff step. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/467
raj: For DAST, I'll tag the finding as "engineer-test-harness" and suppress for 48h while we verify. Add rule: only allow suppression when pipeline-run-id included in finding metadata and suppression auto-expires.
security-bot: New alert rule proposal: logMetric for `protoPayload.methodName="io.k8s.rbac.v1.RoleBinding.create" AND NOT protoPayload.resourceLabels.pr=true` -> send to #eng-alerts and create PagerDuty incident.
maria: Good. Also propose a CI lint to disallow `kubectl` that touch clusters unless step has label `rbac-approved: true`. Owen, can you add that to pipeline linter?
owen: Yep, adding a linter rule and unit tests. Will push change and reference PR 467.
paula: I'll own the incident postmortem. Filed INC-2026-0321-02. Security postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-0321-02
maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: - add correlation id propagation from CI to DAST/logging - ensure KMS access alerts if service accounts decrypt outside scheduled windows - document suppression lifecycle for scanners. Closing thread when postmortem is posted. :white_check_mark:
